description: Conformance cases for the skill publishing rules. Each case is one skill folder, skills/<name>/. Every tool that validates or publishes skills from this repository must give the expect result for every case: pass means no errors (warnings are allowed), fail means at least one error. error is a fragment of this repository's own message, for validate_skills.py only. A file is given as UTF-8 text or as base64 bytes, with an optional Git mode (default 100644). validate_skills.py runs every case before it checks any skill.
